Big dots reliable; small dots can swing lot chance. closer dark line light line, less pressure affects player. Look overall pattern rather single years.

title: Getting started with clutchserve
text: app uses pressure_gap(), can also use . gives one row per player: pressure_pct: share pressure points won other_pct: share service points won gap: pressure_pct minus other_pct. negative gap means player wins fewer pressure points points. app compares player’s gap typical (median) gap: default settings, 201 players least 100 pressure points. typical player wins 2.3 percentage points fewer pressure points service points. luck_limit half-width shaded band: 1.96 × √(p(1 − p) / n), p typical share pressure points won n player’s number pressure points. dot outside band likely combination skill luck: result bigger luck alone usually produce, 200 players, around 10 land outside 95% band chance anyway. treat players outside band worth closer look, proof clutch.
code: players <- pressure_gap(serve_pressure) |>   filter(reliable)  players |>   select(player, pressure_pts, pressure_pct, other_pct, gap) |>   head() #> # A tibble: 6 × 5 #>   player          pressure_pts pressure_pct other_pct     gap #>   <chr>                  <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 Roger Federer           3437        0.659     0.695 -0.0354 #> 2 Novak Djokovic          3119        0.640     0.671 -0.0311 #> 3 Rafael Nadal            2598        0.639     0.661 -0.0226 #> 4 Andy Murray             1810        0.604     0.639 -0.0347 #> 5 Hubert Hurkacz          1624        0.666     0.683 -0.0171 #> 6 Daniil Medvedev         1579        0.631     0.663 -0.0317 typical_gap <- median(players$gap) typical_pct <- median(players$pressure_pct)  players <- players |>   mutate(     vs_typical = gap - typical_gap,     luck_limit = 1.96 * sqrt(typical_pct * (1 - typical_pct) / pressure_pts),     verdict = case_when(       vs_typical >  luck_limit ~ "More clutch than typical",       vs_typical < -luck_limit ~ "Less clutch than typical",       TRUE                     ~ "Within normal variation"     )   )

text: tibble 14570 rows 14 columns. row one player one match, counting points player serving. match_id Match identifier Match Charting Project. date Date match. year Year match. tournament Tournament name, e.g. "Australian Open". round Round tournament, e.g. "QF" (quarter-final), "F" (final). surface Court surface: "Hard", "Clay" "Grass". player serving player. opponent player returning serve. bp_pts Break points faced: points losing lose service game (e.g. 30-40). bp_won Break points won (saved) server. deuce_pts Points served deuce (40-40). deuce_won Deuce points won server. serve_pts points served match. serve_won service points won (first- plus second-serve points won).

text: Break points deuce points come KeyPointsServe file; total service points come Overview file. Cleaning steps (see data-raw/serve_pressure.R): Exact duplicate rows removed. Matches charted twice conflicting counts dropped, correct version identified. Two Davis Cup rows (2024-09-15) values shifted wrong columns dropped match details, removing one match. Matches 1990 removed recorded per year compare players reliably. Matches charted volunteers, data recorded. Well-known players big matches recorded often lesser-known/ lower ranked players. taken random sample sample professional tennis.
